author: Kai Moreno
title: Reserved throughput purchase
content:
# Purpose
How a Dedicated customer buys reserved throughput for a model.

# When to use
How a Dedicated customer buys reserved throughput for a model.

# What Support does
P3, Customer Success. Collect model, tokens/min, start date. Support does not quote price. Do not treat a reservation question as an outage.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P3, Customer Success. Collect model, tokens/min, start date. Support does not quote price. Do not treat a reservation question as an outage. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
